policy: Public-domain/CC0appearance imagery only, Qualla first; questionable sources excluded without questions. Reasonable hidden-detail/terrain estimates remain allowed. Missing whole-body identity/location/scope is not replaced by an unrelated body.

entries.name: Olympic Dam mine
entries.gap: Central mapped buildings and four shaft surface models are complete. Major process-stack correspondence and the remaining actual mine structures are unresolved.
entries.nextUsableEvidence: A distinct whole-body identity/position control for the missing process structures or a bounded original mine inventory; do not transfer1997proposed points into a later built phase.

entries.name: Fray Bentos Pulp Mill
entries.gap: Completed independent buildings and piers do not establish the remaining process vessels and conveyor layout.
entries.nextUsableEvidence: Independent vessel/conveyor positions and whole-body scope, usable with the already cleared government photographs. Normal browser metadata is reachable; original raster download permission was declined and must not be worked around. The on-page elevation readout does not establish these bodies.

entries.name: Fondukistan monastery
entries.gap: The central sanctuary is complete; the monastery annex bodies remain unlocated and unbounded.
entries.nextUsableEvidence: Usable original annex footprint/dimension controls. Museum artifacts and the completed sanctuary do not establish the full monastery.

entries.name: Datong Mass Grave Memorial
entries.gap: The actual memorial/exhibition building is not bound to the original204neighborhood outlines; nearest roofs are not proof of memorial identity.
entries.nextUsableEvidence: A first-party whole-building location/outline or unambiguous public-domain/CC0 architectural coverage. Administrative address and3500m²reported floor area alone are insufficient.

entries.name: Mubarak Mandi Palace
entries.gap: Nine independent members are complete. The eastern residences and GoleGhar still lack whole-body bindings and sufficient architectural form controls.
entries.nextUsableEvidence: Distinct usable eastern-palace/ruin controls. The new Reed city panorama and Drew general descriptions do not identify those bodies; the temporary1905camp arch is separate.

entries.name: Giant Magellan Telescope
entries.gap: Eleven independent support buildings are complete. Actual summit construction and the remaining intrinsic scope are incomplete.
entries.nextUsableEvidence: Actual summit-body or excavation controls and scope decisions. An unbuilt future operating enclosure, site parcel extrusion or unrelated northern observatory building cannot supply the missing physical state.

entries.name: Pierre Auger Observatory
entries.gap: Twenty-seven independent models include the surface-detector array and major campus/fluorescence equipment. Actual AERA antenna positions, XLF and remaining atmospheric equipment are unresolved.
entries.nextUsableEvidence: Actual radio station coordinates and independent equipment/site controls. Generic antenna grids, WCDcoordinates and FDpixel directions are different data.
